name: SearXNG
description: SearXNG is a free internet metasearch engine which aggregates results from various search services and databases. Users are neither tracked nor profiled. This version includes Valkey (Redis) for result caching, reducing rate-limiting from upstream engines. Scrape-based engines (DuckDuckGo, Startpage, Brave) are disabled; the Brave Search API engine is wired in as a reliable primary.
author: searxng

form_fields.label: Brave Search API Key
form_fields.hint: API key from api-dashboard.search.brave.com. Optional but recommended — enables the Brave API engine for reliable results without rate-limiting.
